sections.title: Tingle's Tower
sections.note: Multiplayer only (a Game Boy Advance per player). One mini-game opens per level, after its second stage.

items.name: Bucking Bronco
items.area: Tingle's Tower, after the Cave of No Return
items.howTo: Clear the Cave of No Return in multiplayer and accept Tingle's invitation; the tower lands on the map, and its first portal opens. A horse race: win it or collect the most Force Gems.
items.reward: Force Gems; a Force Fairy per 1,000
items.notes: Clearing the stage in single-player sends the invitation the next time you choose the level in multiplayer. A declined invitation comes back whenever you return to the level. Once open, a mini-game can be played from any Tingle's Tower.

items.name: Cucco Wranglers
items.area: Tingle's Tower, after the Village of the Blue Maiden
items.howTo: Round up the most Cuccos and throw them into the pen.
items.reward: Force Gems; a Force Fairy per 1,000

items.name: Hammer Tag
items.area: Tingle's Tower, after The Mountain Path
items.howTo: Talk to the villager by the tree. Whoever he picks holds the Magic Hammer and chases the others, who run while "it" is dizzy. Fleeing is winning.
items.reward: Force Gems; a Force Fairy per 1,000

items.name: Monster Hunting
items.reward: Force Gems; a Force Fairy per 1,000

items.name: Volley, By Golly
items.howTo: Hit the bouncing ball when it turns your colour. The sign keeps volley records.
items.reward: Force Gems; a Force Fairy per 1,000

items.name: Mole Melee
items.area: Tingle's Tower, after the Desert Temple
items.howTo: Coloured moles pop up: smack the ones of your colour with the squeaky hammer.
items.reward: Force Gems; a Force Fairy per 1,000

items.name: Monster Hunting Returns
items.area: Tingle's Tower, after the Temple of Ice
items.howTo: A harder Monster Hunting: defeat the most enemies.
items.reward: Force Gems; a Force Fairy per 1,000

items.name: Bonus Course
items.area: Tingle's Tower, after The Dark Cloud
items.reward: Force Gems; a Force Fairy per 1,000
items.notes: In this level the tower lands between the first and second stages, as there's no room beside the Palace of Winds.

sections.title: Shadow Battle
sections.note: 2 to 4 players, each on a Game Boy Advance. Battles aren't saved.

items.name: Dark World arenas
items.howTo: Finish the Hyrulean Adventure (defeat Ganon in the Palace of Winds). Five Dark versions of the arenas appear beside the five you start with: The Field, Tower of Flames, Tower of Winds, Hyrule Castle and Above the Clouds. Each Dark arena has a smaller field of view and different hazards.
items.notes: Zelda Wiki, Wikipedia and GameFAQs give this unlock. The manual says only that the number of courses "increases when you clear stages in Hyrulean Adventure"; no source lists another unlock.
